parsed.note_claim: Democrats have been targeted in shootings, including the June 2025 assassination of Minnesota House Speaker Emerita Melissa Hortman and the wounding of State Sen. John Hoffman in a politically motivated attack.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Melissa Hortman was assassinated at her home in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota, United States, by Vance Boelter. Hortman, the leader of the state House Democratic caucus, was shot and killed alongside her husband, Mark.
